title: Apache mod_status page disclosed in a response
description: The response is an Apache server-status page: it carries the module's status heading and the per-worker request table. It lists live requests with client addresses, URLs, virtual hosts and worker state, so it discloses active traffic and internal hostnames.
remediation: Restrict /server-status to localhost with the mod_status Require directive, or disable the module on internet-facing virtual hosts.
limitation: One body marker. The heading is specific to mod_status; a page that links to server-status is not matched.
